1 श्वस् श्व॑सिति, श्व॑सति, ˚ते, pp.
श्वस्त & श्वसित (q.v.) blow, bluster, hiss, whistle, snort,
breathe, sigh. I. only शा॑श्वसत् snorting.—अभि blow hither, hiss,
whistle, groan. आ, पर्या, प्रत्या, & समा get breath, recover, become
quiet. C. quiet, comfort. उद् hiss, pant, gasp, groan, sigh;
 breathe
upwards or out;
 stop or pause from (abl.), recover;
 heave (intr.), get
loose, open, expand. C. cause to take breath, refresh, lift up;
 tear,
rend asunder, interrupt, disturb. प्रोद pant, breathe heavily. समुद्
take breath, recover;
 rise, spring up. C. lift swell (tr.). नि & विनि
hiss, pant, sigh. निस् hiss, pant, breathe out or in, sigh. विनिस्
hiss, pant, snort;
 heave a sigh. प्र blow forth or in, exhale or
inhale. C. cause to breathe;
 quiet, comfort. अभिप्र blow forth upon
(acc.). वि have confidence, be fearless, trust in (loc., gen., or
acc.). C. inspire confidence (acc.). अतिवि have (too) great confidence
in (loc. or acc.). अभिवि C. inspire confidence. परिवि C. quiet,
comfort. — Cf. उच्छ्वसित, निश्वसित, परिविश्वस्त (add.), विश्वस्त,
समुच्छ्वसित.
स्वा॑स् a. sharp-mouthed (Agni) or sharp-edged (axe).
श्वस॑थ m. blowing, hissing, snorting.
